lineage.description: ADAM collected and mapped observed tropical cyclone track data and wind speed measurements from the March 2024 cyclone event. Population exposure was estimated by intersecting wind speed thresholds (60 km/h and 90 km/h) with gridded population data at administrative levels (ADM0-ADM2), producing both spatial vector data and tabular population estimates by wind speed zone.
